title: Conditional κ = 0.001266309796182835: rank151 bit kernel on #451's dual eleven-stage hosting (+0.0299%)
body:
Conditional **κ = 253261959236567 / (2·10¹⁷) = 0.001266309796182835**, **0.0299% above #451** (0.001265931727546219 at `f3a38153`) and 0.0364% above #447. Bit binds: **c = 0.001267915369836389691636** (#451: 0.001267536342017397); the unchanged complex endpoint is b = 0.001268142296690675.

**One change: a larger bit response kernel on #451's construction.** With every helper residual hosted on idle coordinates (no banks), one unit of entrance rank is worth ≈4.4·10⁻⁷ of bit saving, and an extra donor slot costs one local child per invocation (≈0.9·10⁻⁷). A hosting-aware search over donor sets, with closed entrances drawn from intersections of first frames, finds two more pivots on #451's own 57-retimed primitive R740 word:

- 123 pivots, entrance rank **151** (#451: 121 / 149), 120 donor slots;
- #441's 112 pair and 42 window B retimings apply unchanged afterwards. The full e8core replay (legality, F₂ on all columns, source spans) passes;
- 18 regenerated explicit residual isometries. A re-solved #442 selection still hosts all 65,120 helper occurrences, with no banks and no padding.

Everything else is #451's code, byte for byte: the eleven-stage geometry (m = 78), three-level halving (max child 56), row bound 19,431 < 20,161, the complex supplier, both moment engines, the invoices and the 47-inequality outer assembly. The new package `research/r740-hosted-rank151/` is a copy of #451's `r740-hosted-rank149` with only the kernel, word, hosting selection, isometries, expected values and kernel constants changed.

Bit profile: `{1:224264, 2:93744, 3:23712, 4:33912, 5:9512, 6:1936, 7:5104, 8:792, 28:8, 56:456}`.

**Status:** the complete #445 parent replay, rebuild, official C++ legality/columns/k4, record mutations, positive Gram, geometry, emit, independent audit (22 mutations), complex phases/emit/audit (19 mutations) and exact assembly all pass locally (Linux, Python 3.13). A clean full uninterrupted `verify.py` run is in progress and will be posted as a comment. CI is not claimed.

```sh
python -m pip install -r research/e8-r740-replica32/parent436/requirements.txt
python -B research/r740-hosted-rank151/verify.py /absolute/new/output
```

All inherited conditional interfaces stay explicit: #442 idle-data hosting, the all-size compiler, mutable basis, correlated dirty helpers, compressed windows, restored work, tape/common grid, precision, row divisor and analytic transfer. No unconditional theorem is claimed.
